findings.text: 它服务长时间编码会话，试图在有限模型窗口内持续携带决策、错误和代码引用。合格交付是长任务仍能正确利用关键历史，需要精确细节时找回原文，而非只是累计请求很多token或没有超过窗口。名称和README累计B级token不是单次上下文容量扩成十亿，也不是本研究对质量的实测。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 包/代理及状态磁盘 | 固定宿主、备份profile与历史、清旧扩展 | DSH需含dist的发布包 |
| 持续使用 | compress/decompress额外模型回合、输入体积变化 | 检查摘要事实、缓存与session归属 | 全任务费用未知，不套宣传倍数 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试、原文恢复和缓存重建 | 诊断wire-mode、范围映射、双压缩 | 原文和state可用是恢复前提 |
| 退出 | 停代理及移除bundle | 检查gate/preset及原生compact恢复 | 不能只删gate或一个工具 |
[Q05](#research-q05)建议长任务维护者以独立profile、原日志和固定模型比较宿主compact，先验收关键事实再看token。wire-mode持续、双压缩或恢复失败就停用，通过同一bundle通道移除并核对原生compact，不以长会话替代任务/版本管理。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 范围折叠 | summary/ref/保护结构 | 语义保真与任务合格率 |
| 可逆恢复 | active块停用、原消息恢复预览 | 原文/state可用、模型主动恢复 |
| DSH接线 | toolsReady和session归属headers | 实际并发、宿主版本兼容 |
| token/缓存 | 作者报告与机制解释 | 宣传倍数非本轮独立结果，总费用未知 |
[Q02](#research-q02)工具准备和会话归属门控、[Q04](#research-q04)独立compaction gate及失败可见性值得借鉴。kernel纯状态接口与host I/O分开方便移植，但复杂fetch拦截、动态工具和preset替换要求维持精确接口；结构校验不能承担语义验收。
[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)识别的贡献是让模型按范围增量折叠、按需恢复，而非只在达到阈值时全量总结；DSH工具准备与session归属控制把代理状态接到宿主请求。[Q03](#research-q03)支持状态可恢复，不证明所有摘要保真；kernel与vendored机制来源保留，不宣称全新原创。

查看原文（38行） ````text A production-scale longitudinal study: 4.5 months, three hosts, 174,327 model calls, 18.76B cumulative input tokens (~24.7B across all hosts), zero window violations on 204,800-token models, marathon sessions of 8,584–12,049 calls. --- `billion-context` sits between **any** agent and its model API, rewriting Anthropic/OpenAI streams with [acp-kernel](https://github.com/ranxianglei/acp-kernel) compression. The model decides **when** and **what** to compress into high-fidelity summaries — not a hard truncation limit. ## Why Long coding sessions blow up context. Each provider charges per token, and once you pass the context window the session degrades or dies. `billion-context` compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so you can run a single session for days — billions of tokens through one context window. Unlike a host's built-in summarizer, compression here is **incremental, reversible, and prefix-cache friendly**: summaries are written in small ranges, can be decompressed on demand, and the cache prefix stays intact. ## How it works ``` Agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Aider ...) │ you point the agent's base URL at the proxy ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ billion-context│ 1. parse the request (Anthropic or OpenAI shape) │ proxy │ 2. run acp-kernel compression on the conversation │ │ 3. inject a `compress` tool + compression philosophy │ │ 4. forward to the real model API │ │ 5. rewrite the streaming response └─────────────────┘ │ ▼ real model API (Anthropic / OpenAI / compatible) ``` ### Context-management tools The proxy injects four context-management tools into the conversation; the model calls them itself as context grows, and the proxy executes `compress` server-side so folded ranges stay summarized in history until restored: - **`compress`** — fold a message range into a detailed summary. - **`decompress`** — restore a compressed range when exact details are needed again. - **`search_context`** — keyword search over compressed summaries and visible messages. - **`acp_status`** — context-usage overview plus which ranges are still compressible. ````
